skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with clear aesthetic direction. Use for web components, pages, and applications that need polished visual design and working implementation.
skill.summary: Guides AI agents to build polished frontend interfaces with bold design direction.
skill.author: CesarAugustusGroB

security_audit.summary: The three static system-reconnaissance alerts are false positives. The cited SKILL.md lines describe frontend aesthetics, typography, and visual details; they do not request host inspection, secret access, or environment discovery. No prompt injection or semantic abuse evidence was found.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 7 describes the skill's goal of creating distinctive frontend interfaces. It does not instruct the agent to inspect the host system, enumerate files, or collect environment details.
Line 30 gives typography guidance for frontend aesthetics. Font selection advice is not system reconnaissance and does not request access to local system information.
Line 34 recommends visual background details such as textures and shadows. This is design guidance only and contains no host discovery or data collection behavior.

content.value_statement: Generic frontend output often looks repetitive and weakly branded. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward polished, working interfaces with clear visual direction.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of web components, pages, and applications from user requirements.
Prompts a clear aesthetic direction before implementation.
Encourages distinctive typography, color, motion, layout, and visual details.
Supports implementation in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, or similar frontend stacks.
Emphasizes production-grade, functional code with cohesive design choices.
limitations: Does not include runnable source code or templates by itself.
Does not audit accessibility, performance, or security automatically.
May need project-specific constraints to match an existing design system.
Cannot verify browser rendering without an external preview or test workflow.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Product Screen
use_cases.description: Turn a product idea into a polished first-screen interface with a memorable visual direction.

use_cases.title: Upgrade a Component Library
use_cases.description: Refresh shared components with stronger typography, motion, spacing, and interaction details.

use_cases.title: Explore Campaign Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate distinct interface directions for marketing pages, editorial layouts, or branded tools.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Simple Landing Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to build a responsive landing page for [product]. Choose one clear aesthetic direction and implement working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a complete page.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Polished Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to create a [component] for [audience]. Include states, motion, typography, color variables, and responsive behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign an Existing Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to redesign this screen: [describe or paste UI]. Preserve the workflow while improving hierarchy, spacing, interaction, and visual character.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate improvement of an existing interface.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-View Prototype
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to build a multi-view [app type] prototype. Define a bold aesthetic system, then implement navigation, states, and responsive layouts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prototype with multiple screens and states.

output_examples.input: Build a dashboard for a boutique analytics product.
output_examples.output: A responsive dashboard concept with a refined editorial layout, strong data hierarchy, subtle motion, and production-ready implementation notes.

output_examples.input: Create a pricing page for a developer tool.
output_examples.output: A distinctive pricing interface with clear plan comparison, characterful typography, accent colors, hover states, and mobile-friendly structure.

output_examples.input: Redesign a music discovery app screen.
output_examples.output: A polished app screen direction with immersive visuals, practical interactions, and layout choices tied to the listening workflow.

best_practices: Provide the audience, product purpose, required stack, and any existing design constraints.
Ask for one clear aesthetic direction before requesting detailed implementation.
Preview the result across desktop and mobile before accepting the design.
anti_patterns: Requesting a generic modern UI without product context or audience details.
Mixing many visual styles without choosing a primary design direction.
Skipping accessibility, performance, or responsive checks after implementation.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps AI agents create polished frontend components, pages, and applications with stronger visual direction.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it generate complete applications?
faq.answer: It can guide complete frontend views, but backend services and deployment remain separate work.

faq.question: Can it follow an existing design system?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide tokens, components, screenshots, or constraints so the output matches your system.

faq.question: Does it replace a designer?
faq.answer: No. It accelerates interface exploration and implementation, but human review is still important.

faq.question: Is there confirmed malicious behavior?
faq.answer: No confirmed malicious behavior was found in the reviewed skill text.
